parts.name: Drawer (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: A lower drawer made of MDF wood, rectangular in shape, fitting into the lower section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing items; slides in and out of the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Drawer (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: An upper drawer made of MDF wood, located above the lower drawer.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space; slides in and out smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel forming the back of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the left side of the table, made of MDF wood.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawers, maintaining the table’s shape.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the right side of the table, made of MDF wood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral support and holds the drawers in alignment.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel forming the base of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the weight of the structure and provides a stable foundation.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The top surface of the table, made of MDF wood, flat and rectangular.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a surface for placing items or working on.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.
